question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Recession __fettered__ the company from any further investments.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fettered"** means restrained or confined, typically in a restrictive way. (बाधित किया हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **The prisoner was **fettered **to the wall, unable to move freely.
 
 
 
• **"Liberated" **refers to being set free from restrictions or confinement. (मुक्त किया हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **After years of struggle, the nation was finally **liberated **from colonial rule.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'fettered' **is **'liberated'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Concealed **(छुपाया हुआ): Kept hidden or secret.

 
 
• **Example:** The treasure was **concealed** behind a false wall in the basement.
 
 
 
• **Valuable **(मूल्यवान): Worth a great deal of money or highly important.
 
 
• **Example: **She gave me some **valuable** advice on how to handle the situation.
 
 
 
• **Depended** (निर्भर): To rely on someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** The success of the project **depended** on everyone's cooperation.

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
